name: Arrows (20)
description: Ammunition for a shortbow or longbow. Sold and stored in a quiver of 20.

name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
description: Ammunition for a hand, light, or heavy crossbow. Sold and stored in a case of 20.

name: Sling Bullets (20)
description: Ammunition for a sling. Sold in a pouch of 20.

name: Blowgun Needles (50)
description: Ammunition for a blowgun. Sold in a pouch of 50.

name: Burglar's Pack
description: A Backpack, a Bag of 1,000 Ball Bearings, 10 feet of String, a Bell, 5 Candles, a Crowbar, a Hammer, 10 Pitons, a Hooded Lantern, 2 flasks of Oil, 5 days of Rations, a Tinderbox, a Waterskin, and 50 feet of Hempen Rope.

name: Diplomat's Pack
description: A Chest, 2 Cases for maps and scrolls, a set of Fine Clothes, a bottle of Ink, an Ink Pen, a Lamp, 2 flasks of Oil, 5 sheets of Paper, a vial of Perfume, Sealing Wax, and Soap.

name: Dungeoneer's Pack
description: A Backpack, a Crowbar, a Hammer, 10 Pitons, 10 Torches, a Tinderbox, 10 days of Rations, and a Waterskin, plus 50 feet of Hempen Rope.

name: Entertainer's Pack
description: A Backpack, a Bedroll, 2 Costumes, 5 Candles, 5 days of Rations, a Waterskin, and a Disguise Kit.

name: Explorer's Pack
description: A Backpack, a Bedroll, a Mess Kit, a Tinderbox, 10 Torches, 10 days of Rations, and a Waterskin, plus 50 feet of Hempen Rope.

name: Priest's Pack
description: A Backpack, a Blanket, 10 Candles, a Tinderbox, an Alms Box, 2 blocks of Incense, a Censer, Vestments, 2 days of Rations, and a Waterskin.

name: Scholar's Pack
description: A Backpack, a Book of lore, a bottle of Ink, an Ink Pen, 10 sheets of Parchment, a bag of sand, and a small knife.

name: Arcane Focus (Crystal)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard, used in place of material components without a listed cost.

name: Arcane Focus (Orb)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard, used in place of material components without a listed cost.

name: Arcane Focus (Rod)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard, used in place of material components without a listed cost.

name: Arcane Focus (Staff)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard. Also functions as a Quarterstaff.

name: Arcane Focus (Wand)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard, used in place of material components without a listed cost.

name: Druidic Focus (Sprig of Mistletoe)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Druid or Ranger, used in place of material components without a listed cost.

name: Druidic Focus (Totem)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Druid or Ranger, used in place of material components without a listed cost.

name: Druidic Focus (Wooden Staff)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Druid or Ranger. Also functions as a Quarterstaff.

name: Druidic Focus (Yew Wand)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Druid or Ranger, used in place of material components without a listed cost.

name: Holy Symbol (Amulet)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Cleric or Paladin. An amulet is worn or held.

name: Holy Symbol (Emblem)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Cleric or Paladin. An emblem is borne on a shield or worn.

name: Holy Symbol (Reliquary)
description: A spellcasting focus for a Cleric or Paladin. A reliquary is held.

name: Potion of Healing
description: As a Bonus Action, drink to regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

name: Antitoxin (vial)
description: As a Bonus Action, drink to gain Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.

name: Poison, Basic (vial)
description: As a Bonus Action, coat one weapon or up to 3 pieces of ammunition. For 1 minute, a creature hit takes an extra 1d4 Poison damage.

name: Acid (vial)
description: As an action, throw at a target within 20 feet as a ranged attack. On a hit, deals 2d6 Acid damage.

name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
description: As an action, throw at a target within 20 feet as a ranged attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns; it can end this by using an action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check.

name: Holy Water (flask)
description: As an action, throw at a target within 20 feet as a ranged attack. A Fiend or Undead takes 2d6 Radiant damage on a hit.

name: Alchemist's Supplies
description: Artisan's tools for producing useful chemicals and identifying substances.

name: Brewer's Supplies
description: Artisan's tools for brewing beer, ale, and other beverages.

name: Calligrapher's Supplies
description: Artisan's tools for fine lettering and detecting forged documents.

name: Carpenter's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for building and repairing wooden structures.

name: Cartographer's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for drafting maps and charting new areas.

name: Cobbler's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for making and repairing footwear.

name: Cook's Utensils
description: Artisan's tools for preparing meals and improving Rations.

name: Glassblower's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for shaping glass and identifying glass objects.

name: Jeweler's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for cutting gems and appraising jewelry.

name: Leatherworker's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for working leather goods, including leather armor.

name: Mason's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for cutting stone and constructing masonry.

name: Painter's Supplies
description: Artisan's tools for producing paintings and evaluating art.

name: Potter's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for crafting ceramics and identifying their origin.

name: Smith's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for forging and repairing metal items, including metal armor.

name: Tinker's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for making and mending small mechanical devices.

name: Weaver's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for weaving cloth and repairing fabric goods.

name: Woodcarver's Tools
description: Artisan's tools for carving wood, including arrows and bows.

name: Disguise Kit
description: Cosmetics and props for creating visual disguises.

name: Forgery Kit
description: Papers, inks, and seals for producing convincing forged documents.

name: Herbalism Kit
description: Clippers, pouches, and vials for harvesting plants and making remedies, including Potions of Healing.

name: Navigator's Tools
description: Instruments for charting a course and avoiding hazards at sea.

name: Poisoner's Kit
description: Vials and apparatus for crafting poisons and applying them safely.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: Picks and tools for disarming traps and opening locks.

name: Gaming Set (Dice)
description: A set of dice for games of chance and skill.

name: Gaming Set (Playing Cards)
description: A deck of cards for games of chance and skill.

name: Musical Instrument (Bagpipes)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Drum)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Dulcimer)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Flute)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Horn)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Lute)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Lyre)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Pan Flute)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Shawm)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Musical Instrument (Viol)
description: A musical instrument used as a Bard's spellcasting focus and for performances.

name: Backpack
description: Holds up to 30 pounds of gear within a 1-cubic-foot volume.

name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
description: As an action, spill across a 10-foot square. A creature moving through must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity save or fall Prone.

name: Barrel
description: Holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or 4 cubic feet of solids.

name: Basket
description: Holds up to 40 pounds within a 2-cubic-foot volume.

name: Bedroll
description: Bedding for sleeping outdoors during a rest.

name: Bell
description: A small hand bell.

name: Blanket
description: A warm blanket for resting in cold conditions.

name: Block and Tackle
description: A pulley set that lets you hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

name: Book
description: A book of lore, poetry, or records.

name: Bottle, Glass
description: Holds up to 1.5 pints of liquid.

name: Bucket
description: Holds up to 3 gallons of liquid or half a cubic foot of solids.

name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
description: As an action, spread across a 5-foot square. A creature entering must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

name: Candle
description: For 1 hour, sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet.

name: Case, Crossbow Bolt
description: Holds up to 20 crossbow bolts.

name: Case, Map or Scroll
description: Holds up to 10 rolled sheets of paper or 5 rolled sheets of parchment.

name: Chain (10 feet)
description: Has 10 Hit Points and can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

name: Chalk (1 piece)
description: A piece of chalk for marking surfaces.

name: Climber's Kit
description: Pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. As an action, anchor yourself so you can't fall more than 25 feet, and can't move more than 25 feet from the anchor without disconnecting.

name: Clothes, Fine
description: Clothing suitable for formal or aristocratic settings.

name: Clothes, Traveler's
description: Sturdy clothing suited to travel in varied climates.

name: Component Pouch
description: A pouch of material components; can replace any spell component that has no listed cost.

name: Costume
description: A costume for performance or disguise.

name: Crowbar
description: Grants Advantage on Strength checks where its leverage can be applied.

name: Flask or Tankard
description: Holds up to 1 pint of liquid.

name: Grappling Hook
description: Tie a rope to it and throw to catch a ledge or anchor point.

name: Healer's Kit
description: Ten uses. As an action, expend one use to stabilize a creature with 0 Hit Points without a check.

name: Hammer
description: A hammer for driving pitons and spikes.

name: Hunting Trap
description: As an action, set the trap. A creature stepping on it takes 1d4 Piercing damage and stops moving; escaping requires a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check.

name: Ink (1-ounce bottle)
description: A bottle of writing ink.

name: Ink Pen
description: A pen for writing with ink.

name: Jug or Pitcher
description: Holds up to 1 gallon of liquid.

name: Ladder (10-foot)
description: A wooden ladder 10 feet long.

name: Lamp
description: Sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Burns 6 hours on a flask of Oil.

name: Lantern, Bullseye
description: Sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet. Burns 6 hours on a flask of Oil.

name: Lantern, Hooded
description: Sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Burns 6 hours on a flask of Oil; as a Bonus Action, lower the hood to reduce it to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius.

name: Lock
description: Comes with a key. Without the key, it can be picked with Thieves' Tools and a successful DC 15 Dexterity check.

name: Magnifying Glass
description: Grants Advantage on checks to appraise or inspect small or detailed items. Can start a fire in strong light.

name: Manacles
description: Restrain a Small or Medium creature. Escaping requires a successful DC 20 Dexterity check; bursting them requires a DC 20 Strength check.

name: Mess Kit
description: A tin box holding a cup and utensils for eating.

name: Mirror, Steel
description: A polished steel hand mirror, useful for looking around corners.

name: Oil (flask)
description: Burns in a lamp or lantern for 6 hours. As an action, throw at a target within 20 feet: on a hit it is covered in oil, and the next Fire damage it takes is increased by 5.

name: Paper (one sheet)
description: A single sheet of paper.

name: Parchment (one sheet)
description: A single sheet of parchment.

name: Perfume (vial)
description: A vial of pleasant scent.

name: Pot, Iron
description: Holds up to 1 gallon of liquid and can hang over a fire.

name: Pole (10-foot)
description: A wooden pole 10 feet long, useful for probing ahead.

name: Pouch
description: Holds up to 6 pounds within a one-fifth-cubic-foot volume.

name: Quiver
description: Holds up to 20 arrows.

name: Ram, Portable
description: Grants a +4 bonus to Strength checks made to break down doors; a second wielder adds Advantage.

name: Rations (1 day)
description: Dry provisions sufficient to feed one creature for one day.

name: Robe
description: A loose garment worn over clothing or on its own.

name: Rope (50 feet)
description: Has 2 Hit Points and can be burst with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check.

name: Sack
description: Holds up to 30 pounds within a 1-cubic-foot volume.

name: Scale, Merchant's
description: A balance and weights for weighing coins and small goods.

name: Sealing Wax
description: Wax for sealing letters, often stamped with a Signet Ring.

name: Shovel
description: A digging tool.

name: Signal Whistle
description: A whistle for signaling at a distance.

name: Signet Ring
description: A ring engraved with a personal or house crest, used to seal documents.

name: Soap
description: A bar of soap.

name: Spellbook
description: A leather-bound book of 100 blank vellum pages for recording a Wizard's spells.

name: Spikes, Iron (10)
description: Iron spikes that can be driven with a Hammer to wedge doors or anchor a rope.

name: Spyglass
description: Objects viewed through it are magnified to twice their size.

name: Tent, Two-Person
description: A simple canvas shelter that sleeps two.

name: Tinderbox
description: Flint, steel, and tinder for lighting a fire. As an action, light a torch, candle, or lamp; lighting anything else takes at least 1 minute.

name: Torch
description: Burns for 1 hour, providing Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. As an improvised weapon on a hit it deals 1 Fire damage.

name: Vial
description: Holds up to 4 ounces of liquid.

name: Waterskin
description: Holds up to 4 pints of liquid (weight given when full).

name: Whetstone
description: A stone for sharpening bladed weapons and tools.
